items.caption_intent: Exact uploaded Fig. 11 from Fat-containing soft-tissue tumors: Imaging findings and pathologic correlation. Thigh ALT in a 61-year-old man. A/E: predominantly fatty T1-bright mass with thick septa. B: fat suppression. C/F: enhancing septa; supplied caption reports no nodular nonadipose component. G: yellow lobulated fatty gross specimen with fibrous septa. H: caption identifies mature adipocytes and atypical stromal cells in collagenous septa. Molecular confirmation uses MDM2 amplification; this marker is shared with dedifferentiated liposarcoma.
